summary: deAPI offers one API for open-source generative models (text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-speech, text-to-video, image-to-video, audio-to-text, text-to-music, embeddings, upscaling and more). New users get $5 in free credits on signup to test the API.
claim_steps: Sign up for a deAPI account at deapi.ai
The $5 free credit is applied to the new account
